newsitem.title: BELGIUM: AUDIOLUX SAYS TO CUT AUDIOFINA STAKE.
newsitem.headline: AUDIOLUX SAYS TO CUT AUDIOFINA STAKE.

text.p: Luxembourg-based holding company Audiolux SA said in a statement on Friday it would reduce its stake in media holding Audiofina following a restructuring of its shareholder structure.
"The company has the intention to lighten its stake in Audiofina, which will allow it to invest in new projects," Audiolux said.
Audiofina owns 50 percent of Luxembourg media group ~CLT-UFA~. The other 50 percent is held by Germany's Bertelsmann AG .

The statement was released ahead of an extraordinary general meeting of Audiolux shareholders, who were to vote on a reduction in the company's capital and an exchange of their holdings against Audiofina shares. Journalists were not admitted to the meeting.
